description:
Seeking qualified vendors to provide Liebert HVAC Preventitive Maintenance support. We have prepared a Performance Work Statement (PWS) outlining the scope, requirements, and expected deliverables.

Action Required:

  • Vendors are invited to review the attached PWS.

  • After reviewing, vendors may submit estimates, proposals, or recommended solutions in accordance with the requirements detailed in the PWS.

Submission Instructions:

  • Submit proposals/estimates to edgar.clark@usmc.mil

  • Include all requested documentation and any clarifying questions.
